G'day everyone, it's Mick, Jess's dad. Quick message for all the parents after Saturday. First, Ollie is okay. He is home and he is resting. Here is what happened. The waves were small, but Ollie paddled to the north end, near the rocks, and the current pulled him very fast. A wave pushed him onto the rocks and he cut his foot badly. He twisted his ankle too. The boys acted quickly. Renato and Harper paddled out and brought him back to the sand. I had the first aid kit in the van. I cleaned the cut carefully and put a bandage on it, and we drove him to the hospital. The doctor said the ankle is swollen, but it isn't broken. He can't surf for two weeks. So, please, talk to your kids tonight. Stay in the middle of the beach, and stay close to the group. Thanks, everyone.

Hey, Renato, it's Harper. I just want to say thanks for Saturday. Honestly, I panicked a bit when I saw Ollie near the rocks, but you stayed really calm. You paddled so fast. I didn't know you were that quick. And you talked to him quietly, so he didn't get more scared. That was smart. Ollie sent me a photo of his foot. It's purple, it's a huge bruise, and it still bleeds a little at night, so gross. He says he's fine, but he walks really slowly. Anyway, Kai wants to talk about it at training on Tuesday. He's not angry. He just wants everybody to know the rules well. See you Tuesday. And, you know, you surf really well. Just saying.
